args: Frames 2–6, 8 and 9 are good — keep them exactly. Frame 1 landing: much deeper squash, knees bent low, body wider and lower, paws out to the sides. Frame 7 hurt: body FACING RIGHT (nose to the right) but knocked backwards to the LEFT, leaning back, paws thrown forward, surprised face. Frame 10 pickup: bent far forward at the waist, head low, one front paw touching the ground in front of his feet. Every frame faces RIGHT.
